reasons.r0_selected: All three additional revisions failed the predeclared replacement rule; r0 retained, not selected by test performance.
reasons.r1_rejected: Development macro-F1 and NPMI both unchanged. AP improved, but AP is not a replacement criterion.
reasons.r2_rejected: Development macro-F1 unchanged, NPMI gain 0.0092145 is below required 0.02, and coverage falls 0.1084564, beyond allowed 0.05.
reasons.r3_rejected: Development macro-F1 falls 0.0013468 and NPMI is unchanged. Recall improves, but does not independently satisfy the replacement rule.
reasons.stop_target_not_met: Against BERTopic, r0 development macro-F1 is lower by 0.0166343, exceeding the allowed 0.01; all other stopping conditions pass.

limitations: Metadata plus the saved training source establish declared partitions and fit counts; this audit does not independently retrain or recover feature matrices from the pickles.
CPU evidence is the enforced affinity policy and recorded sampled training peak; it is not a new wall-clock instrumentation run.
Topic metrics are unsupervised proxies and do not establish true topic count/boundary accuracy.

r1.behavior: Adds word unigram/bigram TF-IDF to unchanged character features; word vectorizer is fitted separately within each training fold.

r2.behavior: Each 5-message training window receives 1 + 2 * mean(out-of-fold message risk); downstream NMF uses weighted fitting without development/test labels.

r3.behavior: Adds 10-message context transformed by the same fixed topic model, then equal-weight fuses 5-message and 10-message distributions in both training and inference.
